Bookbuilding IPO | ₹39 Cr | Listing at BSE SME | Wed, Sep 23, 2026 - Fri, Sep 25, 2026 O

Liqvd Digital IPO is a book build issue of ₹39.01 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 63.22 lakh shares aggregating to ₹34.14 crores and offer for sale of 9.02 lakh shares aggregating to ₹4.87 crores.

Liqvd Digital IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 23, 2026 and will close on Sep 25, 2026. The allotment for the Liqvd Digital IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 28, 2026. Liqvd Digital IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 30, 2026.

Liqvd Digital IPO is set issue price band at ₹51 to ₹54 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,16,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,24,000.

Indorient Financial Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Shreni Shares Ltd.

Refer to Liqvd Digital IPO RHP for detailed Information.

About Liqvd Digital India Ltd.

Updated on Sep 23, 2026

Incorporated in 2013, Liqvd Digital India Limited is a digital marketing and media solutions company that helps brands build their online presence, reach the right audience, and drive business growth. Its services include social media management, media planning and buying, online reputation management, creative content production, influencer marketing, SEO, performance marketing, and web and app development.

The Company works with a diverse range of clients, including large enterprises, mid-sized companies, and direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands across sectors such as IT and communications, FMCG, logistics, financial services, manufacturing, and healthcare. It operates in India through offices in Mumbai and Gurgaon, as well as an in-house studio in Mumbai for content production and related activities. Through its association with AdLift Inc., the Company also has a presence in the United States.

Its media business focuses on planning and buying digital and offline media with an emphasis on measurable results, return on investment, and audience reach. The Company uses data and creative strategies to develop media campaigns based on client requirements and negotiated contracts.

Its production business focuses on creating visual and multimedia content, including photography, video shoots, drone shoots, podcasts, animation, AI-generated videos, and other branded content. The acquisition of AdLift Marketing is expected to further expand the Company's marketing capabilities and client base.

As of July 31, 2026, the Company and AdLift Marketing had 53 and 119 permanent employees, respectively.

Key Strengths

  • End-to-end digital marketing capabilities covering media planning and buying, creative content, influencer marketing, SEO, and performance marketing.
  • Experienced management team with industry knowledge and domain expertise, supported by a skilled workforce.
  • Diversified client base across multiple industries, reducing dependence on any single sector or customer type.
  • In-house technology and streamlined workflows that support scalable and data-driven marketing campaigns.
  • Strong content production capabilities through an in-house studio and services such as video, photography, podcasts, animation, and AI-based content.
  • Expanding market presence with operations in India and access to international business through AdLift Inc.

IPO FAQs

Liqvd Digital IPO is a SME IPO of 72,24,000 equity shares of the face value of ₹5 aggregating up to ₹39 Crores. The issue is priced at ₹51 to ₹54. The minimum order quantity is 2000.

The IPO opens on Wed, Sep 23, 2026, and closes on Fri, Sep 25, 2026.

Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar for the IPO. The shares are proposed to be listed on BSE SME.

Zerodha customers can apply online in Liqvd Digital IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Liqvd Digital IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form.

Steps to apply in Liqvd Digital IPO through Zerodha

  1. Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console.
  2. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link.
  3. Go to the 'Liqvd Digital IPO' row and click the 'Bid' button.
  4. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price.
  5. Submit IPO application form.
  6. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM) to approve the mandate.

Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

The Liqvd Digital IPO opens on Wed, Sep 23, 2026 and closes on Fri, Sep 25, 2026.

Liqvd Digital IPO lot size is 2000, and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,16,000, with 2 lots being the minimum application size.

You can apply in Liqvd Digital IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha, Upstox, 5Paisa, Nuvama, HDFC Bank, and SBI Bank.

The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Liqvd Digital IPO will be done on Monday, September 28, 2026, and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 29, 2026. Check the Liqvd Digital IPO allotment status.

The Liqvd Digital IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 30, 2026.
